props.gloss_en: the mishna: slaughtered it and its daughter's daughter and then its daughter -- he incurs the forty
Sumakhos in R' Meir's name: he incurs eighty
Sumakhos holds: one who ate two olive-bulks of forbidden fat in one lapse of awareness is liable two sin-offerings
by right it should have taught [Sumakhos] in general; it taught it in this case to show the strength of the Rabbis -- though the bodies are separate, the Rabbis exempt
or perhaps Sumakhos holds: two olive-bulks of fat in one lapse -- liable only one
and here [in the mishna] the reason [for eighty] is that the bodies are separate
one who sows kilayim, kilayim, is flogged
[the reading] he is flogged once
[the reading] he is flogged twice
[the case is] one after the other, with two warnings
[the case is] at once, with one warning
a nazirite who was drinking wine all day is liable only once
if they said to him 'do not drink' and he drinks, 'do not drink' and he drinks -- he is liable for each and every one
[the kilayim ruling is] the Rabbis', who dispute Sumakhos
[the kilayim ruling is] Sumakhos's
it teaches in passing that there are two kinds of kilayim: one who sowed wheat with a grape-seed, or barley with a grape-seed, is also liable
R' Yoshiya: [one is not liable] until he sows wheat, barley and a grape-seed in one throw of the hand
ate an olive-bulk from this [nerve] and an olive-bulk from that -- he incurs eighty
R' Yehuda: he incurs only forty
[the case is] one after the other, with two warnings
[the case is] at once, with one warning
we have heard R' Yehuda say: an uncertain warning is not called a warning
struck this one and then struck that one, cursed this one and then that one, or struck both at once, or cursed both at once -- liable
R' Yehuda: at once -- liable
R' Yehuda: one after the other -- exempt
[the tanna kamma is] the Rabbis, who dispute Sumakhos
[the tanna kamma is] Sumakhos
this tanna holds like the other tanna [reporting] R' Yehuda, who says an uncertain warning is called a warning

'you shall not leave of it until morning, and what remains of it until morning you shall burn' -- the verse comes to give a positive command after the negative, to say that one is not flogged for it: the words of R' Yehuda
R' Yaakov: not for that reason, but because it is a negative command without an act
and for any negative command without an act one is not flogged
ate two nerves from two thighs of two animals -- he incurs eighty
R' Yehuda: he incurs only forty
[the case is] one after the other, with two warnings
[the case is] at once, with one warning
[the tanna kamma is] the Rabbis, who dispute Sumakhos
[the tanna kamma is] Sumakhos
and as for 'what is R' Yehuda's reason' -- [it is a case] where [one nerve] has no olive-bulk
ate it [the whole nerve] and it has no olive-bulk -- liable
R' Yehuda: [not liable] until it has an olive-bulk

schemas.gloss_en: השתא ומה התם דגופין מוחלקין פטרי רבנן, הכא לא כל שכן -- if the Rabbis exempt [from a second set of lashes] in the mishna, where the bodies are separate, here [sowing kilayim at once] all the more so
השתא ומה התם דגופין מוחלקין פטרי רבנן, הכא לא כל שכן -- the same a fortiori, for eating from both nerves at once
ומה התם דגופין מוחלקין פטרי רבנן, הכא לא כל שכן -- the same a fortiori, for eating two nerves at once

supports.gloss_en: ממאי? מדתנן: הזורע כלאים כלאים לוקה -- two floggings for one act with one warning, which only Sumakhos could hold

deflected_by.gloss_en: לא, לעולם רבנן, ומילתא אגב אורחיה קא משמע לן דאיכא תרי גווני כלאים -- the mishna is the Rabbis', and its repetition has another job

supports.gloss_en: תא שמע: אכל מזה כזית ומזה כזית -- סופג שמונים; at once with one warning, so the tanna kamma would be Sumakhos

deflected_by.gloss_en: לא, לעולם בזה אחר זה, ורבנן -- the case is sequential and the tanna kamma the Rabbis

supports.gloss_en: תא שמע: אכל שני גידין משתי ירכות משתי בהמות -- סופג שמונים; at once with one warning, so the tanna kamma would be Sumakhos

deflected_by.gloss_en: לעולם בזה אחר זה -- sequential; R' Yehuda's forty is because one nerve lacks an olive-bulk

supports.gloss_en: דתניא: הכה את זה וחזר והכה את זה... רבי יהודה אומר: בבת אחת חייב, בזה אחר זה פטור
דתניא: לא תותירו... בא הכתוב ליתן עשה אחר לא תעשה לומר שאין לוקין עליו, דברי רבי יהודה -- for that reason only, not because the warning is uncertain
דתניא: אכלו ואין בו כזית חייב; רבי יהודה אומר: עד שיהא בו כזית

eliminated_by.gloss_en: פשיטא! ועוד, מאי כלאים כלאים? -- once is obvious, and then why repeat 'kilayim'?

frames.gloss_en: במאי עסקינן? -- sequential with two warnings, or at once with one?

eliminated_by.gloss_en: תנינא: נזיר... אמרו לו אל תשתה והוא שותה... חייב על כל אחת ואחת -- that is already taught (p_nazir_al_kol_achat)

rebuffed_by.gloss_en: מילתא אגב אורחיה קא משמע לן דאיכא תרי גווני כלאים, ולאפוקי מדרבי יאשיה -- the repetition is not idle: it teaches two kinds of kilayim (p_trei_gavnei_kilayim)

eliminated_by.gloss_en: השתא ומה התם דגופין מוחלקין פטרי רבנן, הכא לא כל שכן? (kv_rabbanan_kilayim)

frames.gloss_en: היכי דמי? -- sequential with two warnings, or at once with one?

eliminated_by.gloss_en: מאי טעמא דרבי יהודה? התראת ספק היא, ושמעינן ליה לרבי יהודה דאמר התראת ספק לא שמה התראה -- sequentially R' Yehuda would not flog at all

rebuffed_by.gloss_en: והאי תנא סבר לה כאידך תנא דרבי יהודה, דאמר התראת ספק שמה התראה (p_ry_hatraat_safek_shma_hatraah)

frames.gloss_en: ומאן תנא קמא? -- the Rabbis or Sumakhos?

eliminated_by.gloss_en: השתא ומה התם דגופין מוחלקין פטרי רבנן, הכא לא כל שכן? (kv_rabbanan_mizeh_umizeh)

rebuffed_by.gloss_en: לא, לעולם בזה אחר זה, ורבנן

frames.gloss_en: היכי דמי? -- sequential with two warnings, or at once with one?

eliminated_by.gloss_en: מאי טעמא דרבי יהודה דאמר ארבעים ותו לא? -- sequentially with two warnings, why only forty?

frames.gloss_en: מאן תנא קמא? -- the Rabbis or Sumakhos?
